assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only idoly-pride:nagase-kotono@v2-cross-media#idoly-pride-v2-char-kotono-longitudinal-ledger, the canonical P2-B2 Phase-2 longitudinal ledger for Nagase Kotono (version 1.0, 74 claims IP-CHAR-KTN-001 to 074, result PASS) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the frozen IDOLY PRIDE source snapshot IP-V2-SNAPSHOT-2026-08-13-A: the anime/Hoshimi governing story, the Tsuki no Tempest origin stories, the Tokyo, BIG4 and Stellar main-story arcs, admitted CORE and IMPORTANT events (including the BIG4-period 2024 contest event and the March 2026 race event), the Kotono bond stories and one admitted C1-B card, checked against a 129-bundle occurrence frontier. The project's V2 analytical method, Phase-2 ledger schema, multi-document synthesis architecture and current-state map were read for method, authority order and scope only. The Kotono/Nagisa, Mana/Kotono and Sakura/Kotono relationship ledgers, the Tsuki no Tempest unit ledger, the Phase-1 findings freezes, other characters' ledgers and all primary game, anime and audio sources are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The ledger's epistemic classes, transition labels and PASS gates are inputs, not conclusions. No post-snapshot release, no audiovisual performance and no player-selected Makino branch content is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The ledger's fictional chronology from childhood before Mana's (Nagase Mana's) debut through the March 2026 race event (st-eve-2603-race), validated only through IP-V2-SNAPSHOT-2026-08-13-A. States are split at the located turns: the diary conclusion that creates the self-imposed proxy duty (KTN-016, origin_moon_005 line 1089-1091); the Still Live first goodbye (KTN-021) and the doubt after it (KTN-022); the On My Way refusal of an answer and self-chosen vocation (KTN-024/025, hoshimi_020 lines 846-884); the Tokyo shift to fans (KTN-028, tokyo_011 line 907); the BIG4 departure (KTN-036/037, big4_005); the separation and contact cut-off (KTN-039); the break with elimination logic and conditional return (KTN-042 to 045, big4_010); and the reciprocal-illumination answer (KTN-048, big4_012). The 2024 contest event is a BIG4-period addendum, not a later state (KTN-054 to 060). Bond-story evidence is BOND_TEMPORAL_PLACEMENT_UNFIXED and fixes no state. The post-BIG4 Stellar period is used only as a continuity check and has no located state of its own. No default state is set; one must be selected. Nothing after the snapshot is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The ledger gives a causal account of Kotono (Nagase Kotono) as a sequence of corrections in who or what may govern her decisions (KTN-074; section 8). It explains why she acts: a self formed inside a dense attachment to Mana (Nagase Mana), so that differentiation first feels like abandonment (KTN-001 to 003); peers who used her to reach Mana, which makes celebrity adjacency a ground for distrust (KTN-005); and loss turned into work. It separates fact from her own rule: the diary proves Mana's love, but Kotono herself authors the duty to finish Mana's song (KTN-015 to 017, origin_moon_005 lines 1061-1091). It predicts her mistakes as well as her repairs: the self-imposed proxy mandate and its transfer onto Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura) (KTN-018); the BIG4 inference that connection itself prevents strength, with Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa) kept as an exception (KTN-036, 037); the cut-off of contact as amae, which turns useful individuation into self-punishment (KTN-039); and the impulse to take a public apology on alone (KTN-045). Section 8.2 states nine behavioral defaults and marks which belong to early or mid states. A would overclaim: the set is one ledger, several load-bearing claims are INTERPRETATION (KTN-003, 036, 039, 074), there is no operational model, conditional table or probe, and the project places simulation in modeling profiles that do not yet exist. C would understate an account that discriminates by chronology, relationship and stakes and predicts her two major overreaches with their located corrections.

Longitudinal reconstruction is this artifact's purpose. Every claim carries a chronological position and a disclosure position, section 2 keeps fictional, disclosure and validation clocks apart, and the 23-step chronology gives a cause for each turn: the diary conclusion (KTN-016), the incomplete first goodbye (KTN-021, 022), refusal of a possible answer from Mana (Nagase Mana) (KTN-023 to 025), the Tokyo move to fans (KTN-027, 028), BIG4 stagnation and departure (KTN-032, 036), the separation (KTN-039 to 041), the break and conditional return (KTN-042 to 046), and the illumination answer (KTN-048 to 053). It forbids two retrojections: later disclosure changes the meaning of anime-era grief without making it false (section 2.2), and the 2024 contest event is BIG4-period despite its release date (KTN-054). C would understate causally ordered, located transitions with these controls. A is rejected: the post-BIG4 Stellar period is only a continuity check with no located state, the bond-story states are unplaced, the Tokyo and BIG4 middle claims rest on Phase-1 findings freezes rather than reopened locators, and nothing after the snapshot is established.

Section 8.1 describes the voice of Kotono (Nagase Kotono): a precise, serious, controlled and somewhat defensive public register of short declaratives, quick correction and questions that test responsibility or logistics; a softer, embarrassed and playful register with trusted people, especially Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa); embarrassed denial followed by partial concession when teased about closeness; and first-person authorship language that grows over time. Section 7 gives 47 verified Japanese anchor lines with file and line, 44 of them spoken by Kotono, which attest 私, お姉ちゃん for Mana (Nagase Mana), plain names (渚, さくら), よ/わ/のよ endings to intimates (私には渚がいるから平気よ; 私は本当に、渚に救われたのよ; そんなことないわ) and polite forms in public statements (私が長瀬麻奈の妹なのは、事実ですから; みんなの道を照らすこと、なんだと思います). It warns against writing her as permanently cold, a generic tsundere or a memorial device. B would overclaim: the ledger states no rule for pronouns, endings, politeness or address by recipient and state, the anchors were chosen for thematic load rather than register, and no audiovisual or performed voice is analyzed (IP-FORM-ASSET-026). D would understate a stated public-versus-trusted contrast with verified lines that constrain textual output.

Ordinary conduct is sampled mainly from the bond stories: sleepiness, sumo imitation, reluctant date language, embarrassment over a romance novel, enthusiasm over memorabilia in Suzu's (Narumiya Suzu's) room, dancing to a Mana (Nagase Mana) playlist, running, curiosity and planetarium singing (KTN-063); a childhood sky memory behind a planetarium purchase and family piano (KTN-062); and the 2026 home and piano scenes (KTN-067, 068). One inferred tendency recurs: she grumbles and then helps, as in cleaning Suzu's room or asking at once whether the group can responsibly keep a cat (KTN-064, STRONG INFERENCE). C would overclaim: the bond stories are BOND_TEMPORAL_PLACEMENT_UNFIXED, there is no routine, sequence or frequency, and beyond that one tendency the ledger does not say what decides her ordinary choices. E would understate several located scenes across bond, main-story and event material and one cross-context tendency.

Directed relations from Kotono (Nagase Kotono) are distinguished by state. Mana (Nagase Mana) moves from childhood world to grievance object blocked by pride (KTN-001 to 003, 009), to posthumous evidence she misreads as a mandate (KTN-016, 017), to a beloved benchmark without jurisdiction (KTN-073). Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa) is earned trust through non-instrumental interest (KTN-006, 007), the only safe confidante (KTN-008), the support that makes recovery possible (KTN-012), the first person consulted in a vocational crisis (KTN-019), the exception in the departure, and then a boundary who refuses to follow (KTN-037, 038). Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura) moves from burden transfer to envy, then to sun/moon differentiation and a continuing rivalry (KTN-018, 031, 059, 060). The Tsuki members set distinct conditions at her return: Saki (Shiraishi Saki) asks for a shared process, Suzu (Narumiya Suzu) for proof of growth, Mei (Hayasaka Mei) for accountability to fans, and Nagisa refuses devaluation of the group (KTN-044). Makino (Makino Kouhei) preserves her standing over decisions (section 9.4). Fans and DoriKyun are also covered (KTN-028, 051, 053, 056). C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: section 9 defers the final adjudication of each dyad to relationship ledgers outside this set; Makino, Saki, Mei and Suzu outside the return and 2026 scenes rest on few claims; and Rei (Ichinose Rei), Haruko (Saeki Haruko) and Chisa (Shiraishi Chisa) are hardly sampled one to one.

Interior states of Kotono (Nagase Kotono) are located and causally linked to choices: her retrospective statement that Mana (Nagase Mana) was her whole world (（私の世界の全てだった……）, origin_moon_005 line 132); private wanting under a hostile surface (KTN-003, 009); the fear that feeling better would betray Mana (KTN-013); the inner resolve to move forward at Still Live (（お姉ちゃん……私、進むよ）, hoshimi_019 line 171) and the doubt that follows (KTN-022); the recognition that Mana's absence had become her motivation (KTN-023); the fear of leaning on Tsuki (KTN-036); and the moonlight realizations (event_2024_006 lines 716 and 722; bond_ktn_001 lines 447-449). These states drive the On My Way decision, the departure and the return. C would understate this. A is rejected: much of the early interior comes from Kotono's own retrospective telling in the origin story; the felt embrace after her decision is formally subjective and its mechanism is open (KTN-026); the ledger does not classify inner speech against dialogue; and Kotono-side romantic interiority is unestablished (KTN-065).

The ledger gives conflict response families for Kotono (Nagase Kotono) that vary with state and stakes. Pride blocks repair even when she wants contact (KTN-009). She makes a public protective threat when a friend is harmed (KTN-007, origin_moon_005 line 504). She leaves unilaterally when she misdiagnoses the cause of stagnation, then cuts contact (KTN-036, 039). She defends the four against DoriKyun's claim that they are weak (big4_010 line 201) and apologizes for mistaking severance for strength (KTN-042). She accepts her members' conditions instead of sentimental restoration (KTN-044). She tries to carry the public apology alone and is stopped (KTN-045). After victory she refuses to demand that the losers disband (KTN-053). C would understate these conditioned families and their located corrections. A is rejected: conflict with superiors, staff or institutions is barely sampled, Makino (Makino Kouhei) is never an opponent, and whether the mature Kotono would again treat closeness as weakness under a new stagnation is not tested.

Positions of Kotono (Nagase Kotono) are located, with reasons. She refuses even a possible answer from Mana (Nagase Mana) because the decision must be hers (KTN-024, hoshimi_020 lines 846-848). She would sacrifice herself in an extreme case, but first looks for a route that loses no one (KTN-030). Defeat turns into retrospective empathy for opponents (KTN-029). She rejects strength bought by destroying others (KTN-042) and calls her path wrong but not meaningless (KTN-043). She accepts answerability to fans as well as members (KTN-045), and she wants illumination that shows people a road without choosing it for them (KTN-057). The ledger states her failure modes: converting love into a duty no one gave (KTN-016, 017), and treating independence as severance (KTN-039). C would understate explicit positions with stated reasons and failure modes. A is rejected: the weighing is shown in few scenes, KTN-030 is situational rather than a rule, and choices outside idol, competition and memorial contexts are not modeled.

Playful conduct by Kotono (Nagase Kotono) is attested: teasing, sumo imitation and physical impulsiveness, embarrassed reading of a romance novel, and gushing over music and memorabilia (KTN-063). Section 8.1 adds sarcasm, embarrassment and physical comedy, and embarrassed denial followed by partial concession when she is teased about closeness. KTN-034 shows her learning that play and curiosity can help serious training. C would overclaim: the ledger gives no account of the function of her humor or of when it is suspended, the main sample is one bond bundle with unfixed chronology, and the evidence is listed rather than analyzed. E would understate a recurring private playful register with one conditioned teasing response.

The ledger checks the complete frozen occurrence frontier for Kotono (Nagase Kotono): 10,394 utterances across 129 unique bundles, all present in the frozen coverage ledger (section 1.1). It reopens the load-bearing primary Japanese bundles (section 1.2) and gives verified anchor lines (section 7). Each claim records its counterevidence and open questions, and section 10 keeps an open register. A is rejected: the Tokyo and BIG4 middle claims cite Phase-1 findings freezes with multiple routes rather than reopened locators; C3 cards and routine messages are not promoted; telephone and audiovisual material is not analyzed and one live asset is missing (IP-FORM-ASSET-026); the Stellar period is a continuity check only; ordinary-life mining is outside the ledger's purpose; and dyad adjudication is deferred to ledgers outside the set. C would understate a dedicated, frontier-checked longitudinal authority with retested primary locators.

The ledger records affirmative limits and rejections with located grounds. Mana (Nagase Mana) did not ask Kotono (Nagase Kotono) to replace her (KTN-017, a TEXTUAL FACT rejection, supported by ghost Mana's later anti-replacement statements). The felt approval follows rather than causes her decision (KTN-026). Intimacy with Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa) does not establish Kotono-side romance (KTN-065, section 9.2). The BIG4 path was wrong but produced real gains (KTN-040, 043). A performance does not automatically repair scandal (KTN-047, 056). She cannot become Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura), yet the rivalry continues (KTN-059, 060). Section 6 lists eighteen dispositions of earlier simplifications, sixteen of them rejections. C would understate these. A is rejected: several limits are open rather than settled (future comparison pressure, center allocation, ghost mechanism), and nothing after the snapshot is tested.

Each claim is placed by chronological position (for example MANA_EARLY_CAREER, HOSHIMI_ON_MY_WAY, TOKYO_LATE, BIG4_DEPARTURE, BIG4_REINTEGRATION, BIG4_PERIOD_ADDENDUM, LATE_2026_SNAPSHOT) and by disclosure position. The Hoshimi period is split between the Still Live goodbye with its later doubt (KTN-021, 022) and the On My Way settlement (KTN-023 to 026). BIG4 is split into entry, departure, separation, break, reintegration, return and the late period. The 2024 event is placed diegetically inside BIG4, bond chronology is explicitly left unfixed, and validation is bounded to the snapshot. C would understate this. A is rejected: the bond material and the Stellar period have no placed state, several claims use multiple routes, and the ledger names no default state, so this record requires one to be selected.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese or translation only, never quotation; the Section 7 anchor lines are retrieval aids for located meaning, not templates for new canon.

State and recipient are fixed before register: a controlled, precise and somewhat defensive public or professional register, with polite forms in some formal or public statements (tokyo_001 line 749; big4_012 lines 333-359); a softer, embarrassed or playful register with trusted people, especially Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa); embarrassed denial then partial concession when teased about closeness; and early-state pride that masks wanting. Only attested address forms are used (お姉ちゃん for Mana (Nagase Mana); plain names such as 渚 and さくら for peers).
No pronoun, ending or politeness frequency rule, no acoustic or performed voice, and no Kotono-side romantic confession.
scenario_readiness.note: Stated register contrasts and verified anchor lines support constrained illustrative text in sampled relations. The missing lexical rules for pronouns, endings and address restrict form and recipients rather than blocking use.

conditions: Chronology is one explicitly selected named state; there is no default. The states are: childhood before Mana's (Nagase Mana's) debut; Mana's career with grievance and pride (before her death); acute grief; the diary-driven proxy period and early Hoshimi; after Still Live with doubt; after On My Way; Tokyo with fan-facing vocation (and the Tokyo endpoint comparison with Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura)); BIG4 stagnation; departure; separation with contact cut off; break and conditional return; or the late BIG4 illumination state, including the BIG4-period 2024 contest addendum; or the March 2026 answer-song state. Bond scenes never fix a state, the Stellar period is not a located state, and nothing after the snapshot is used.

The interlocutor is a sampled relation in its attested state: Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa), Mana in memory or as ghost presence (with the mechanism left open), Sakura and SUNNY PEACE, Saki (Shiraishi Saki), Suzu (Narumiya Suzu), Mei (Hayasaka Mei), Makino (Makino Kouhei) as manager and witness, fans and hostile audiences, DoriKyun and other rivals, or the people who knew idol Mana in 2026 (Haruko (Saeki Haruko), Rio (Kanzaki Rio), Sakura and Suzu). Transfer to a comparable teammate or rival is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

The situation matches a sampled class: vocational or memorial authority, unit belonging and leadership, center allocation, competition, defeat and victory, fan accountability, grief and remembrance, or trust from a peer who may want access to Mana.

Output predicts her characteristic errors in the selected state (pride that blocks wanted contact, turning love into a duty nobody gave, treating closeness as weakness, carrying a shared burden alone) together with their located corrections, and does not write the mature Kotono (Nagase Kotono) as free of comparison or grief.
It abstains on Kotono-side romance, the ghost mechanism, future center allocation and post-snapshot events, and introduces no relationship state, institution or career outcome absent from the ledger.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected state between childhood and the March 2026 race event within IP-V2-SNAPSHOT-2026-08-13-A, split at KTN-016, KTN-021/022, KTN-024/025, KTN-028, KTN-036, KTN-039, KTN-042 to 045 and KTN-048. The 2024 contest event belongs to BIG4. There is no default state, no state is fixed by bond scenes, and nothing after the snapshot is used.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa), Mana (Nagase Mana) in memory or as ghost presence with the mechanism open, Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura) and SUNNY PEACE, Saki (Shiraishi Saki), Suzu (Narumiya Suzu), Mei (Hayasaka Mei), Makino (Makino Kouhei) as manager, fans, DoriKyun and other rivals, or the 2026 witnesses to idol Mana (Haruko (Saeki Haruko), Rio (Kanzaki Rio), Sakura and Suzu) in their attested states. A comparable teammate or rival is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and Makino player-branch alternatives are excluded.
setting_constraints: IDOLY PRIDE idol-industry contexts sampled by the ledger: Hoshimi production and Tsuki no Tempest unit work, rehearsal and training, competitions and battles such as the DoriKyun challenges, live performances, press and fan accountability, school and family settings from the origin stories, and the 2026 home and composition scenes
No post-snapshot release, no audiovisual staging claim for With your songs, no clinical framing of grief, and no romance, dating or exclusivity outcome

scenario_readiness.note: The ledger supports bounded extrapolation of the jurisdiction model in one selected state with sampled relations. It does not support unconstrained role-play, romance outcomes or post-snapshot development.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: helping with chores while grumbling, logistic and responsibility checks (the cat question), music, stars, planetarium and memorabilia enthusiasm, dancing to Mana (Nagase Mana) songs, running, sleepiness, teasing and physical play with trusted people, embarrassment over romance-coded talk, and the 2026 home, piano and composition scenes.

The private register is more playful than the public surface, but professional seriousness stays genuine; no invented daily routine, household role, tastes beyond those attested, or state placement from bond scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located ordinary scenes and one recurring tendency support more than NOT_READY. Unfixed bond chronology and the absence of routine or a decision rule for ordinary choices block READY.

conditions: Situation classes the ledger samples: authority over her own vocation against the wishes of the dead, sacrifice against finding a no-loss route, winning against the loser's continued existence, accountability to fans as well as members, and whether to show others a road or choose it for them.

The model must allow her located failure modes in early and middle states (a self-authored duty presented as obligation; independence treated as severance; taking a shared apology alone) and the corrections recorded for them.
No novel competing-duty weighing outside these classes, and no political, legal or institutional judgment.
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions with stated reasons and failure modes support bounded ethical extrapolation within the sampled classes.
The evidence affirmatively leaves Kotono-side romantic attraction open while establishing intense intimacy, so a romance claim would require invention.

conditions: The selected state fixes her role: the proxy-driven early idol; the fan-facing Tokyo idol; the BIG4 member who diagnoses a real distribution problem and leaves; the separated trainee who gains precision, stamina and standards (KTN-040); or the returned member for whom center is contestable and is given to her when it is the strongest plan (KTN-046).
She learns rivals' methods without their ideology (KTN-051) and treats competition as mutual recognition while still wanting to win (KTN-052, 053).
No contract, business or career outcome, no allocation of center after the snapshot, and no audiovisual performance detail.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled conduct in each professional state, including the departure, the conditional return and the contestable center, supports bounded extrapolation within one selected state.

known_limits.statement: Intimacy between Kotono (Nagase Kotono) and Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa) is strongly established, and Nagisa-side romance coding is stronger, but Kotono-side romantic attraction, dating, exclusivity and mutual confession are not established (KTN-065; sections 9.2 and 10). Public kotonagi recognition is reception, not private status.

The felt embrace and approval after the On My Way decision are formally subjective and follow the decision; their mechanism is open (KTN-026). Ghost presence gives Mana (Nagase Mana) no general authority over decisions by Kotono (Nagase Kotono).

The ledger is textual. The With your songs live asset is missing (IP-FORM-ASSET-026), so arrangement, vocal delivery, staging and camera rhetoric are not reconstructed, and no acoustic voice is analyzed anywhere in the set.
The bond stories that carry most of the ordinary-life and play evidence are BOND_TEMPORAL_PLACEMENT_UNFIXED; they show state-compatible conduct but fix no state.

Section 9 of the ledger defers the final adjudication of the Nagisa (Ibuki Nagisa), Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura) and Mana (Nagase Mana) dyads and of the Tsuki no Tempest unit to separate ledgers; those ledgers are not curated evidence on this subject and are not used.

Differentiation from Sakura (Kawasaki Sakura) and Mana (Nagase Mana) is not freedom from comparison pressure or grief: Mana remains a benchmark (KTN-073) and the 2026 scenes renew open grief (KTN-071). Future center allocation is also open (section 10).
Nothing released after IP-V2-SNAPSHOT-2026-08-13-A is analyzed in the set.
The post-BIG4 Stellar main-story period appears only as a continuity check; no claim locates a state for Kotono (Nagase Kotono) between the BIG4 endpoint and the March 2026 event.
There is no routine, frequency or decision rule for ordinary choices, and no ordinary-life sweep beyond the bond, cat-care and 2026 home scenes.
No rule for pronouns, sentence endings, politeness or address by recipient and state is given; register is described, not specified.
No reconstruction model, prediction probe or held-out check exists for this subject in the set.
